ovt-7613ce95-3431-4b48-a8fd-a7ef8334904a._confidence: org's own divisional site (Northeast Ohio Division) lists a Huron service unit; no hours published anywhere on it
ovt-7613ce95-3431-4b48-a8fd-a7ef8334904a._url_finding: The URL we hold (https://centralusa.salvationarmy.org/indiana) is the Salvation Army INDIANA DIVISION (USA Central Territory) and is NOT this place. Huron, Ohio falls under the Northeast Ohio Division (neo.salvationarmy.org). The held URL should be replaced.
ovt-7613ce95-3431-4b48-a8fd-a7ef8334904a._notes: Huron is a volunteer-run SERVICE UNIT, not a staffed corps. The divisional Service Extension page lists Huron, Erie County, zips 44839 / 44879, phone 419-433-0500. Third-party directories give a different number (419-366-1721) and an address of 820 Cleveland Rd E; the two numbers are NOT reconciled by any first-party source, so only the divisional-site number is proposed below. Yellowpages/countyoffice list 'appointment only' - NOT recorded as hours, no first-party source states it.
ovt-7613ce95-3431-4b48-a8fd-a7ef8334904a.description: A Salvation Army Service Unit serving Huron and Erie County. Per the Northeast Ohio Division: "A Service Unit is located in a community church building or other facility, run solely by volunteers, and may offer a full limited array of services such as: Utilities, Prescriptions, Food vouchers and pantries, Gasoline, Rent & lodging, Back to school supplies, Coats for Kids, Residential Camping, Angel Tree".

ovt-1961226d-15f9-4845-a4c5-618997855901.description: A tuition-free, K-6 public charter school that integrates Ohio state academic standards with daily competitive athletics and physical conditioning, which it calls "the Blitz Model." ovt-7dac6e71-435c-432d-9d45-09fe3a64243d._notfound: THIS PLACE NO LONGER EXISTS. The Huron City Schools district site (huronk12.org, to which the held URL huronhs.com/CentralOffice.aspx now 307-redirects) lists only Woodlands Elementary, McCormick Middle and Huron High School - Shawnee is absent from the school list. The Huron Board of Education voted to close Shawnee Elementary at the end of the 2022-23 school year (last day 2023-05-26) under a consolidation plan, and the building was auctioned and sold for $1.6M. Its address, 712 Cleveland Road E., is now occupied by Huron Sports Academy (huro-lst-0021). Shawnee survives on the district site only as the mailing location of the Title IX Coordinator. No hours, no description, and no phone of its own exist to record. Recommend the listing be marked closed/defunct rather than enriched.

ovt-ec05a600-8bb3-4039-bc37-0720d83a3f59._confidence: ALL fields are verbatim or near-verbatim from the restaurant's OWN site. Hours are printed in the site footer on every page. Menu was parsed from the HTML text of /breakfast/ and /dinner-lunch/, not from a PDF or image — item names, descriptions and printed prices are transcribed, none inferred.
ovt-ec05a600-8bb3-4039-bc37-0720d83a3f59._address: 218 Cleveland Rd. East, Huron, Ohio 44839 — phone 419-433-4123
ovt-ec05a600-8bb3-4039-bc37-0720d83a3f59._hours_note: Footer, verbatim: 'Monday: Closed / Tuesday - Saturday: 7:00am - 8:00pm / Sunday: 7:00am - 1:00pm (Serving Breakfast Only)'. Monday omitted per the schema. ⚠️ SUNDAY IS BREAKFAST ONLY — the open/close pair does not carry that restriction. ⚠️ A SECOND, NARROWER WINDOW EXISTS that these hours cannot express: the breakfast menu page states 'Breakfast hours are 7am-11am Tuesday through Saturday. 7am – 1pm on Sundays.' See dining-NOVEL.md §'Meal-period windows inside opening hours'.
ovt-ec05a600-8bb3-4039-bc37-0720d83a3f59.description: A family-owned Huron restaurant opened in 1979 by Albert and Roseanne Berardi and now in its fourth generation, serving scratch-made American, Italian and Lake Erie seafood dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
ovt-ec05a600-8bb3-4039-bc37-0720d83a3f59._description_basis: Condensed from the operator's own About text: 'Berardi's Restaurant in Huron was opened in 1979 by Albert and Roseanne Berardi and it is still family owned to this day… currently in the 4th generation… nearly everything we serve is made from scratch.' Menu content confirms the cuisine claim.
ovt-ec05a600-8bb3-4039-bc37-0720d83a3f59._amenities_basis: Online ordering = the site's own order link https://order.toasttab.com/online/berardis-huron. Catering = /catering/ page in the nav. Gift cards = 'Purchase New Gift Card Here' / 'Check Gift Card Balance Here'. Beer and wine = 'Check out our new beer and wine list!' plus named beers on Today's Specials. Gluten-free bread = printed on the menu ('Gluten Free Bread is available for all sandwiches 1.00'). Waitlist = the site's Google waitlist link. ⛔ 'Takeout' is inferred ONLY from the presence of the Toast online-ordering link; if that is too weak, drop it.
ovt-ec05a600-8bb3-4039-bc37-0720d83a3f59._menu_note: Machine-readable HTML, transcribed in full below. Two further menus exist that were NOT transcribed: /catering/ and a Dessert menu linked in the footer. Items marked '(Market Price)' in the description carry no price key, correctly. Soups print two prices (cup/bowl, e.g. '4.50/8.00') which this schema's single `price` cannot hold, so the printed pair is left in the description and `price` is omitted.
